# East Anglia AI Services

> Specialist AI automation consultancy delivering custom AI agents, workflow automation, predictive intelligence, LLM integration, data pipelines, AI ops and AI training for small and medium businesses across Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire and Essex (UK). Founded and run by Petar Petkov.

East Anglia AI Services (EAAIS) builds and deploys production AI systems for SMEs — not generic software, but automation designed around how a specific business already works. Typical engagements: invoice-processing automation, AI voice agents for customer service, predictive demand forecasting, LLM-powered chatbots grounded in a company's own documents, continuous AI ops monitoring for deployed models, and hands-on AI training for staff. Projects typically go from discovery to a live system in a matter of weeks. Contact: info@eastangliaaiservices.co.uk, +44 7466 951175.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/): Overview of services, live interactive demos, regional coverage, process and FAQ.
- [AI Training for Businesses](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/ai-training.html): Hands-on AI training for staff, including team workshops, leadership briefings and role-specific sessions on safe, productive AI use, delivered on-site across East Anglia or remotely UK-wide.
- [Free AI Readiness Assessment](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/ai-readiness.html): A free 10-question, 2-minute quiz that scores a business's AI readiness and gives tailored recommendations.
- [Business Loss Calculator](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/loss-calculator.html): A free calculator that estimates how much a business is losing yearly to missed calls, slow lead response and manual admin — with an instant breakdown and recommendations.
- [Free AI Use Policy Generator](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/ai-policy-generator.html): A free tool that generates a tailored internal AI use policy — covering approved tools, data handling, acceptable use, human review and UK GDPR compliance — from 8 quick questions about the business.
- [Blog](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/): Practical, plain-English articles on AI automation for East Anglian businesses.
- [Your Team Is Already Using AI. Has Anyone Shown Them How?](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/ai-training-for-business-east-anglia.html): Why staff who already use AI informally still need training, what the research says, and what practical AI training looks like for a small business.
- [GPT-6 Astra vs Claude Fable 5.1](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/gpt-6-astra-vs-claude-fable-5-1-east-anglia.html): A benchmark-backed comparison of OpenAI's and Anthropic's newest models, and what actually matters when choosing one for a business.
- [Buy, Rent, Subscribe or Ask First?](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/ai-consultant-vs-buy-rent-subscribe-east-anglia.html): Why talking to an AI specialist beats chasing the "best" AI model off the shelf.
- [Local LLMs for Business](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/local-llm-business-east-anglia.html): Why East Anglian firms are bringing AI in-house with private, locally-hosted models.
- [How the Right AI Helps Small Businesses Grow](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/ai-growth-small-business-east-anglia.html): Evidence and starting points for AI-driven growth in East Anglia's small business sector.
- [Voice Agents in Customer Service](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/voice-agents-customer-service-east-anglia.html): How AI voice agents answer every call, book jobs, and cut missed-call losses.

## Service area

Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Essex — including Norwich, Ipswich, Cambridge, Colchester, Peterborough, Bury St Edmunds, Chelmsford and King's Lynn. Remote delivery is available UK-wide.
